packages.title: Nature Props Surface Forest
packages.creator: Reactorcore (RC Art)
packages.licenseEvidence: The OpenGameArt item page identifies this pack as CC0. Its download contains the original individual transparent PNGs and contact sheet.
packages.attribution: Not required by CC0. Optional credit: ‘Nature Props Surface Forest’ by Reactorcore via OpenGameArt, CC0 1.0.
limits: The pack grants rights to the artwork, not to any unrelated trademark, patent, privacy or publicity rights; it is provided without warranty.
These are visual assets only. Their presence does not add collision, interaction, rewards, inventory items or game mechanics.
The source page does not disclose whether AI tools were used; this record makes no inference about that.
packages.sourceNotes: The author describes the sprite scale as about 32 pixels per meter and recommends point filtering. Mossvale keeps source pixels unchanged; map placement controls display width.
